questions.q: What does an Oracle Fusion Expenses mileage rate actually reimburse?
options: Only the exact cost of gasoline purchased
A flat monthly stipend regardless of miles driven
A per-mile rate intended to cover fuel, wear, insurance, and depreciation together
The purchase price of the vehicle
questions.explain: Mileage reimbursement is a per-mile rate covering the overall cost of using a personal vehicle, not just fuel.

questions.q: What can cause a mileage rate schedule to vary rather than being a single flat rate?
options: The employee's favorite color
The time of day the trip occurred
Mileage rates can never vary under any circumstances
Vehicle category or type, number of passengers, or role
questions.explain: Rate schedules can be configured to vary by vehicle category/type, number of passengers, or employee role, though Castellan uses one flat company-wide rate.

questions.q: What is the core idea behind per diem?
options: It pays a fixed daily rate for meals and incidentals instead of requiring itemized receipts
It requires MORE itemized receipts than normal meal claims
It eliminates reimbursement for meals entirely
It only applies to airfare
questions.explain: Per diem simplifies meal and incidental reimbursement into one fixed daily allowance tied to destination and dates, without needing receipts.

questions.q: Why would a per diem amount be reduced on a specific day of a trip?
options: Because the employee exceeded their mileage limit
Because a meal deduction applies when a meal, like a conference breakfast, was already provided
Because per diem rates can never apply on travel days
Because the employee forgot to submit a receipt
questions.explain: Meal deductions reduce the per diem amount on days when a meal was already provided, so the company does not pay twice for the same meal.

questions.q: Why does Castellan use per diem for domestic travel but itemized meal receipts for international trips?
options: Per diem is simpler to audit domestically, while actual meal costs vary too widely internationally for one schedule to be fair
International employees are not allowed to claim any meals
Per diem is illegal outside the United States
There is no reason; the choice is arbitrary
questions.explain: A company chooses per diem or itemized meals deliberately per business unit or trip type based on how well a fixed rate reflects real costs.
